embedded_text_layer_reliability: UNRELIABLE. pdftotext extraction of the embedded OCR text layer produces reversed/interleaved Hebrew (classic bidi/column-order corruption, consistent with the project's own documented legacy Hebrew-OCR bidi hazard). It was NOT used as a transcription source. All Input-layer transcription in this scan was produced by direct visual reading of the rendered page images (220dpi PNG) by the extracting agent (Claude, vision-capable), cross-checked page-by-page against page-header numerals for continuity.

pagination_finding.summary: Two co-printed pagination tracks run across the same leaves for the main Bahir+commentary section (PDF pages 25-43): a Hebrew-letter foliation (recto side of each leaf, e.g. 'יא'=11) and an Arabic page number (verso side of the same leaf) equal to 2x the Hebrew leaf number.
evidence: PDF p25 recto='יא'(11) / PDF p26 verso='22' (=11*2)
PDF p27 recto='יב'(12) / PDF p28 verso='24' (=12*2)
PDF p29 recto='יג'(13) / PDF p30 verso='26' (=13*2)
PDF p31 recto='יד'(14) / PDF p32 verso='28' (=14*2)
PDF p33 recto='טו'(15) / PDF p34 verso='30' (=15*2)
PDF p35 recto='טז'(16) / PDF p36 verso='32' (=16*2)
PDF p37 recto='יז'(17) / PDF p38 verso='34' (=17*2)
PDF p39 recto='יח'(18) / PDF p40 verso='36' (=18*2)
PDF p41 recto='יט'(19) / PDF p42 verso='38' (=19*2)
PDF p43 recto='כ'(20, colophon page 'תם ספר הבהיר')
pagination_finding.status: high-confidence pattern derived from direct observation across 10 consecutive leaves; not verified against an external bibliographic catalog record, so recorded as a Finding, not asserted as canonical provenance fact.
pagination_finding.open_question: PDF page 44 ('דבר אל הקורא', an editorial afterword/essay signed by the same editor/printer) is numbered Arabic '40' -- consistent continuation of the verso-Arabic track (would be 'verso of leaf כ'=20*2=40) even though the main text's colophon already appeared on p43 recto. Whether p44 is a second independent leaf-verso or a structurally separate appended essay sharing the same running Arabic pagination is UNRESOLVED -- flagged as a Finding/candidate, not resolved.
